integrity: Proof and explicit recurrence are supplied; numerical checks are finite corroboration only; literature novelty is evidence-limited. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the b=1/2 mixture from Example 3.9, fixed strictly positive initial data, and bounded observation-time offsets; no general stochastic-operator perturbation theorem or uniform scaling for growing offsets is asserted. The fixed mixing-parameter amplitude is proved to exist but is not computed in closed form.
title: A moving-time extinction crossover in a three-type stochastic mixture
